models.name: v-model:active
models.description: V-model will bind to value containing the current active item.

models.name: v-model
models.description: V-model will bind to value containing selected items.

props.name: items
props.description:
The items to be listed.
The items will be listed in the given array order.

props.name: keyAttribute
props.description:
Unique attribute in items.
V-for directive in vue requires a unique key to
be able to optimize reuse of components.

props.name: selectable
props.description: If `true` the list will be selectable.

props.name: checkbox
props.description:
Only applies if selectable:true
Disable checkbox in interactive list and create a <a>-wrapper for each item, making them clickable

props.name: elementId
props.description: Unique item id that will be used instead of the automatically generated one.

events.name: change
events.description: Emitted when item is activated, i.e. clicked

events.name: click
events.description: Emitted when item is activated, i.e. clicked

slots.name: default
slots.description: Slot for displaying an item. The item object is available through `v-slot="{ <propertyName> }"`, e.g. `v-slot="{ item }"`.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Slot for displaying a message when list is empty. Default text is 'Listan är tom' (key fkui.list.empty).

slots.name: screenreader
slots.description: Slot for screen reader text when checkbox (to selecte item) get focus. The item object is available through `v-slot="{ <propertyName> }"`, e.g. `v-slot="{ item }"`.

bindings.name: item
bindings.description: The object to be screen read.
